summary: Auto-generated templates appear in the catalog with custom ones. If the job template has Prompt on Launch options or survey questions the portal shows a form (resources picked by name, credentials handled automatically); otherwise the job starts immediately. An output page shows the job ID, status and a link to AAP.
questions: Why does my portal template run without a form?
What do users see when launching an auto-generated template?
Does the portal show credentials on the launch form?
